scripts.build: tsc -b && vite build && vite build --ssr src/entry-server.tsx --outDir .prerender --emptyOutDir && node scripts/prerender.mjs
scripts.format: prettier --write src scripts index.html *.json *.jsonc vite.config.ts README.md
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src scripts index.html *.json *.jsonc vite.config.ts README.md
